gbm_population_evidence.quote: with recurrent or progressive WHO Grade II Diffuse Astrocytoma, Grade III Anaplastic Astrocytoma or recurrent WHO Grade IV Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: During the preoperative period, all subjects will be given a course of orally administrated CC-90010 at 30 mg once daily for 4 consecutive days on Cycle 1 Day 1 to Day 4.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subject must be in first or second recurrence.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Intratumoral concentration of CC-90010 in tumor tissue collected intraoperatively

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: CC-90010-GBM-001 is a multi-center, open-label study to assess the pharmacokinetics (PK), pharmacodynamics (PD) and CNS penetration of CC-90010 following short-term interval therapy (4 daily doses ) prior to surgery

coder_notes: Window-of-opportunity phase 1 with intratumoural drug concentration as primary outcome. PD is a stated objective but no specific PD marker is named in outcomes; target_engagement coded yes on the stated PD objective (no paired sampling described) - adjudicator may prefer unclear. Archival tissue for genetic testing required but no specific biomarker named. cns5_terminology unclear: plain 'WHO Grade IV Glioblastoma' with no IDH or WHO edition reference.
